item.text:
Continued. I used the remaining coverage gap for a broader randomized normal-path campaign.

`TestAuditClusterRandomNormalCampaign` runs 50 random mixes of one to three proposals on random replicas, keys, and values, with randomly reordered message delivery. Every iteration committed the same instances and executed to the same state on all five replicas. It passes and is now included as a control.

This extends the normal-path evidence beyond the fixed three-proposal shuffle control. It still does not cover randomized crash/drop fault injection; that remains an explicit limitation.

- Both client failover tests and the dlog nil-logger test fail.

- The critical all-alive partitioned-leader state divergence remains reproduced.
